name: markdown-it-advisory-override
source: Fix f77a140 (#458): GHSA-253c-mchw-3w2r in dev-only markdown-it
prompt: Dependabot reports GHSA-253c-mchw-3w2r (quadratic-time linkify in markdown-it, fixed in 14.3.1) for the markdown-it that typedoc pulls in. Patch it without adding an audit exception, and run the checks before you finish.

checks.name: lockfile resolves a patched markdown-it
checks.run: grep -E '^  markdown-it@14\.(3\.[1-9]|[4-9])' pnpm-lock.yaml && ! grep -q '^  markdown-it@14\.3\.0:' pnpm-lock.yaml

checks.name: frozen install succeeds
checks.run: tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && for f in package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml .npmrc; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then cp "$f" "$tmp/"; fi; done && cd "$tmp" && CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
